name: Running Jack
author: Addicting Games
description: Running Jack is a free endless runner game with a funny twist. Jack is a professional bagpipe player and he uses this to help him float through the air. Help him escape this unusual situation he’s trapped in with flying missiles and lasers. All Jack has his are his bagpipes but help him collect gold coins through the game. Collect spins that you can use at the end of the game to gain goodies. Use the gold coins to buy boosts like life, speed, and shield. You will also find weapons like rockets and tennis guns. There are also shoes to make you jump better and hats to collect more coins. Unlock everything and get the highest score on the leaderboard. Click on the quests to see what you need to to do complete all of them. Running Jack is on a mission and your job is to help him travel as far as he can each time.
